# EmmanuelMacronChess
Chess moves played by Emmanuel Macron's comments. Start with: d4, d5, c4, c6, Nf3, Nf6, Nc3, e6. Play out maximum 10 more half-moves

## Usage
Copy the Python file from this repo to your own computer. It will take a move and play out the rest of the game as if Emmanuel Macron was the player.

You can also use the commands:
- `chess_submission.py` - To download the chess sets from the official website.
- `check_moves.py` - To check if a move is legal in a real game of chess and still remains in the list of moves.

## Example
```
./chess_submission.py
```
